summary: Updates `@msw/url` to 0.1.3 so a handler matches when an optional or `*` parameter after another parameter is omitted.
Preserves optional path parameters and pipes in handler paths.
Bug fixes: update `@mswjs/interceptors` to 0.45.11, and add `handler` to the request:match event.
Bug fixes: prevent the worker from going idle, and treat `.ico` as a common asset.
Bug fixes: reset handlers are now disposed, and network context is exposed on `enable` in network sources.
